## Rollback

Revert the PR. All changes are additive (one module, one builder plus two constants, one manifest, one inventory row, one `_AGENT_BY_CATALOG_PROFILE` entry, one test file) and nothing calls them, so a revert has no runtime effect. If the mctl-gitops profile/binding for `authoring-canary` have already merged, revert those first (or in the same window) so the catalog check does not see a profile mapped to an absent agent; once the canary is published by a release, removal follows the same governed path in reverse as stated in the issue.
